question: Can even the lord of speech become weary and diminished by the god of love?
premises: The beautiful god of love causes weariness.
Even the lord of speech is subject to this effect.
Such influence can render one lowly.
inference: No being, however eloquent, is immune to the exhausting power of desire.
plain_english: Even the lord of speech becomes weary and lowly under the influence of the beautiful god of love.
